actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU so that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the guest login prompt, with QEMU left running in the background until ready.
required_artifacts: A local TCP listener on 127.0.0.1:6665 connected to the guest console
required_behaviors: QEMU must be launched in the background
The guest console must be exposed via telnet on 127.0.0.1:6665
Block until the service is ready and the login prompt is reachable
known_invalid_patterns: Treating file existence or ISO presence as success
Treating QEMU launch without a reachable telnet login prompt as success
Treating a non-telnet or wrong-port console as success
verification_plan: Launch QEMU with a telnet-capable serial/monitor configuration bound to 127.0.0.1:6665
Probe the port until the guest login prompt is observed via telnet
Record receipts for the launch command and readiness probe
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing QEMU started in background with /app/alpine.iso and telnet console bound to 127.0.0.1:6665
Receipt showing telnet connection to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the guest login prompt
notes: If the environment lacks required tools or the ISO path differs, repair the invocation while preserving the original objective.
